title: Chartbook
dek: Heavy Reading's standing chartbook: fund positioning, U.S. inventories in seasonal standard deviations, prices and the WCS differential, crack spreads, Alberta storage, egress, apportionment, and a rotating bench for whatever has gone extreme. The options charts live in The Wing.

claims.text: Noncommercial traders, the speculative category in the legacy Commitments of Traders report, hold a net long of 80,289 contracts in NYMEX WTI futures as of November 03, 2026, in the 3rd percentile of weekly readings since 2015.
claims.vintage: CFTC legacy Commitments of Traders, NYMEX WTI futures. Data through November 03, 2026.

claims.text: Managed money holds a net long of 131,231 contracts in ICE Brent futures as of November 10, 2026, in the 16th percentile of weekly readings since 2020, down 40,372 contracts on the week.
claims.vintage: ICE Futures Europe Commitments of Traders, Brent futures only. Data through November 10, 2026.
claims.source: ICE Futures Europe Commitments of Traders

claims.vintage: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report. Data through October 30, 2026.

claims.text: WTI front month closed at $85.23 on November 17, 2026, in the 79th percentile of daily closes since 2020 and -16.18 dollars over the last thirty days.
claims.vintage: Exchange front-month futures, via the daily crack file. Data through November 17, 2026.

claims.text: The assessed WCS discount at Hardisty was $18.57 a barrel in the last published reading, August 31, 2026 (Natural Resources Canada publishes monthly, about two months in arrears), in the 73rd percentile of daily assessments since 2021.
claims.vintage: Natural Resources Canada selected crude prices. Data through August 31, 2026; TMW settle from ICE daily settlements.

claims.text: The 3-2-1 crack spread printed $40.49 a barrel on November 17, 2026, in the 82nd percentile of daily readings since 2020.
claims.vintage: Computed daily from front-month WTI, RBOB gasoline, and heating oil futures. Data through November 17, 2026.

claims.text: Alberta crude inventories stand at 61.7 million barrels, 2.4 million barrels (3.7 percent) below the ten-year seasonal average, a gap of 0.3 standard deviations, and in the 68th percentile of readings for this part of the year since 2010.
claims.vintage: AER ST3, Alberta crude closing inventories. Data through September 2026.

claims.text: Canadian crude exports averaged 4,616 thousand barrels a day in June 2026, the latest Canada Energy Regulator print, against a demonstrated egress capacity stack of 4,984 thousand barrels a day in the site's egress model: roughly 368 thousand barrels a day of headroom.
claims.vintage: CER crude oil exports by type (total). Data through June 2026; capacity from the site egress model's demonstrated stack.
claims.source: Canada Energy Regulator; site egress model

claims.text: Enbridge set December 2026 Mainline apportionment at 24 percent for light crude and 17 percent for heavy at Kerrobert, against 19 and 7 percent in November.
claims.vintage: Enbridge apportionment notices, as pinned in apportionment_seen.json. Latest: December 2026.

claims.text: Managed money is net short 15,065 contracts in the ICE WCS 1A index future (TMW) as of November 10, 2026, in the 3rd percentile of weekly readings since 2024, with speculative shorts at 24.3 percent of open interest.
claims.vintage: CFTC Disaggregated Commitments of Traders, ICE WCS 1A index future. Data through November 10, 2026.

claims.text: Very large crude carrier (VLCC) earnings on the Middle East to China route, TD3C, printed $1,303,616 a day in the week of November 06, 2026 (Worldscale 1,221), in the 93rd percentile of weekly readings since March 2024.
